entries.title: The Park

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the original full release, has PC capture/settings flexibility, and well-documented PC tweak/support information. The console and Switch releases do not add exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Park on Steam for Windows PC and play the native PC release; check for configuration notes before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release with PC capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and best capture/fidelity route for the complete game.
skip: same game route, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expanded edition is documented.
